answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond that only unlocks after a history of useful, peer-attested work, so a sybil farm pays the same cost per identity as honest agents do. A new identity starts in a shallow harbor of limited trust and earns deeper access slowly, like an opal gaining its fire from many thin layers, while an umber-stained record of failed attestations marks fakes for all to see. Cheap copies cannot fake time, so the attack stops scaling.
